title: Godot OOB Read leads to heap metadata corruption
body:
### Tested versions

Should be reproducible on main branch latest version (same networking code). My POC used 4.4.1-stable.

### System information

Windows 10 4.4.1-stable

### Issue description

Hi! SceneReplicationInterface::on_spawn_receive() has an OOB read that allows corrupting heap metadata.

While investigating https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121450 I realized ofs was bounded by 18 so the initial bug reported was not exploitable (my bad, I missed that during initial triage). However, 

for this check: https://github.com/warsang/godot/blob/6f6e09e16bdd8998f051083be9c3cdd04c3bcab1/modules/multiplayer/scene_replication_interface.cpp#L586

```name_len + (sync_len * 4) > uint32_t(p_buffer_len - ofs) ```

Can wrap-around (meaning it won't trigger the assert) while still being very large. this is client/attacker controlled.

When sync_len = 0x40000001, the multiplication sync_len * 4 wraps in uint32 so we get:

0x40000001 * 4 = 0x100000004 which wraps to 0x00000004
4 + 20 (name_len) = 24
remaining = 42 - 18 = 24
24 > 24 evaluates to false and the check passes.

This now large sync_len is later used in the following sink:

```
for (uint32_t i = 0; i < sync_len; i++) {
    sync_ids.push_back(decode_uint32(&p_buffer[ofs]));
    ofs += 4;
}
```

I compiled the engine with ASAN enabled ( https://github.com/warsang/GodotOOBDemo/tree/master ) and using the [following script](https://github.com/warsang/GodotOOBDemo/blob/master/godot-3d-multiplayer-template/scripts/exploit/oob_spawn_exploit.gd) attached to a new node on the client, I was able to trigger the following ASAN trace:

### Steps to reproduce

1. Compile engine with ASAN enabled
2. Use https://github.com/warsang/GodotOOBDemo/tree/master/godot-3d-multiplayer-template or just use the exploit script node on a client and hit a Godot server
3. Observe the ASAN exception being thrown

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Please refer to https://github.com/warsang/GodotOOBDemo/tree/master/godot-3d-multiplayer-template for the MRP.
